description.value: Macau Cafe (澳門街) is a Chinese fast food cafe situated in the busy Number 3 Road retail corridor of Richmond, BC. It serves the large local Cantonese community and is a convenient stop for cyclists navigating Richmond's flat, bike-friendly grid streets through the city's commercial heart.
